topic.title: Now Available: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1981–1988, Volume XVI, South America: Ecuador, Paraguay, Uruguay, and Venezuela chapters
topic.body: These chapters document the Reagan administration’s approach to relations with Ecuador, Paraguay, Uruguay, and Venezuela. The remaining chapters in the volume will be released as they are cleared for publication.
